# 打印错误码 / Print error codes · 1A

[返回索引 / Index](../../PRINT-ERROR-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| `0x1A004001` | 挂架粗回中失败，打印已取消，请检查是否有异物阻碍挂架运动。 | Rack coarse homing failed. Printing has been canceled. Please check if any obstruction is blocking the rack movement. |
| `0x1A004007` | 挂架标定失败，请检查助手。 | Rack calibration failed, please check the Assistant. |
| `0x1A004008` | 热端挂架上热端已装满，无法进行热端切换。请移除一个热端后继续。 | The hotend rack is fully occupied, and hotend switching cannot be performed. Please remove one hotend before proceeding. |
| `0x1A004009` | 挂架未完成初始化，无法执行热端更换操作。请先在设备上完成初始化后再继续。 | The Rack has not been set up. Please complete the Setup before performing a hotend replacement. |
| `0x1A008002` | 挂架回中失败，检测到异物阻塞。请清除异物后恢复打印。 | Rack homing failed due to an obstruction. Please remove the obstacle before resuming printing. |
| `0x1A008003` | 挂架回中距离过长，请检查同步带是否松动或断裂。 | Rack homing distance is abnormally long. Please check whether the timing belt is loose or broken. |
